board.name: Kansas State Board of Healing Arts

options.text: Each year: at least 50 hours in the preceding year, at least 20 of them Category I and at least 1 Category III
Every two years: at least 100 hours in the preceding two years, at least 40 of them Category I and at least 2 Category III
Equivalent hours, in number and category, verified by a national, state or local organization with standards at least as stringent as the board's

exemption.field: Initially licensed within a year of this renewal
exemption.question: Were you first licensed as a Kansas PA within one year of this renewal date?
exemption.text: A PA first licensed within one year of a renewal date is exempt from the continuing education for that first renewal.

topics.label: Category III: acute or chronic pain management, appropriate opioid prescribing, or use of prescription drug monitoring programs, at least 1 hour a year

agreement.text: Before practicing, the PA files an active practice request signed with the responsible physician; amendments go to the board within 10 days and the physician reviews the form at least annually. From January 1, 2027, a PA attesting to 4,000 or more postgraduate clinical hours, with no disciplinary action on the license, may practice in collaboration with a physician; under 4,000 hours, under physician supervision with a written practice agreement.
